title: torque_task_progress input@1
description: Non-parking progress report. Unlike torque_task_checkpoint_emit, it never parks. Never changes task status and never creates a checkpoint. Dropped (emitted=false) when level is above the effective progress_detail; a repeated idempotency_key returns duplicate before any rate limit applies.

run_id.description: Torque run id (numeric, as a string); must belong to task_id

data_ref.description: artifact id or data.emitted event id
